# Level Best Billiards

> The leading professional billiard service in the Atlanta metro area. We specialize in expert pool table moving, setup, repair, and recovering, as well as the sale of new and used tables, cues, and game room furniture.

## Services

* [Pool Table Moving Service](https://www.levelbestbilliards.com/move.html): Expert moving, knock down service, disassembly, and professional setup of all brand pool tables.
* [Pool Table Recovering](https://www.levelbestbilliards.com/recover.html): Extend the life of your table with new felt, including Simonis, ProLing ProForm and Championship cloth options.
* [Pool Table Repair](https://www.www.levelbestbilliards.com/repair.html): Professional repair for slate block, rails, legs, and other table components.
* [Cue Stick Repair](https://www.levelbestbilliards.com/store/cue-stick-repair.html): Details on professional cue repair and tip replacement services.

## Products

* [New & Used Pool Tables](https://www.levelbestbilliards.com/store/pool-tables.html): A list of all available pool tables, including in-stock new and used options.
* [New Pool Tables](https://www.levelbestbilliards.com/store/new-pool-tables.html): Shop our selection of brand new tables.
* [Used Pool Tables For Sale](https://www.levelbestbilliards.com/store/used-pool-tables.html): Current inventory of pre-owned pool tables organized by size.
* [Game Room Furniture and Accessories](https://www.levelbestbilliards.com/store/game-room-furniture.html): Options for poker tables, shuffleboard, and other game room items.
